text:
Maya: FYI invoice INV-2026-042 for Acme (on-prem) is flagged — looks like a usage true-up + support tier change. Can billing ops confirm what's going on?
Arjun: pinging @Raj — customer said they moved to Premium support in the amendment. Invoice shows Standard.
Nora: Acme signed amendment (link: https://redwood.example/contract/ACME-2024-AMEND) and PO PO-7788 attached. We listed Premium on the amendment effective 2026-02-15.
Raj: Thanks — I'll pull the invoice. can you paste the invoice PDF or quick line items?
Maya: attaching quick excerpt: ```INV-2026-042
1) Dedicated capacity - $12,000
2) Support (Standard) - $2,000
3) Usage true-up (GPU hrs) - $4,500
4) Platform fee - $0  <-- should be $1,500
Total - $18,500```
Raj: billing-bot just uploaded the source invoice and event: invoice.uploaded INV-2026-042 (see admin panel). I'll reconcile.
billing-bot: invoice.uploaded INV-2026-042 by Nora at 1765550123.
Raj: Found the issue — when amendment processed, support tier flag updated but platform_fee_rate stayed at legacy 0 due to a migration edge-case. I will re-run proration and regen invoice.
Arjun: we need a corrected invoice and a short note for Acme explaining the true-up + proration. Also cc finance@redwood on reissue.
Maya: please include the signed amendment and PO in the communication. We should avoid surprise charges; recommend adding a one-line explanatory footnote: "Platform fee proration for 2026-02-15 to 2026-03-31 per amendment ACME-2024-AMEND"
Raj: Agreed. I'll issue INV-2026-042A and set due_date +30, include footnote, and mark the previous one as superseded. Draft message to customer: ```Hi Acme team — attached corrected invoice INV-2026-042A reflecting Premium support and proration per amendment ACME-2024-AMEND. No change to usage true-up amount; platform fee prorated $1,500. Invoice supersedes INV-2026-042. Please let us know if you need additional docs (PO: PO-7788). Thanks, Raj (Billing Ops)```
Nora: I'll send the draft from CS and loop the customer success owner. Can you also add an internal note for revenue ops so forecasts adjust?
Raj: adding revenue ops tag now. Created ticket REVOPS-1129 and linked invoice.
Maya: thanks — do we need exec approval to reissue? This is routine but material (~$1.5k).
Arjun: no exec sign-off needed but please route through Finance approval queue so we have audit trail.
Raj: done. Submitted to finance-approvals queue (ticket FA-3291). ETA for reissue ~ 2 hours after approval.
Maya: perfect. @Nora can you schedule a 15m call with Acme if they ping? Maybe Wed 10am PT works.
Nora: scheduled provisional slot Wed 10:00 PT, will confirm with Acme. Adding :white_check_mark:.
Maya: thanks all. Please post once INV-2026-042A is out and share the reissue link. :thumbsup:
